Safety ... on 3 June, 2024 
Author: Justicejaved Iqbal Wani
Bench: Justicejaved Iqbal Wani
 Sr. No. 227
 Supp. List
 In The High C0Urt 0F Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
 Crm(M) 310/2024 CrlM(755/2024)
 Ali Mohammad Bhat And Ors. ... Appellant(s)/Peti 
 Through: Mr. Jahangir Iqba Ganai, Sr. Adv. with
 Mr. Mir Kamil Nazir, Advocate
 Vs.
 Union Territory Through Food Safety Officer Zone ... Resp
 Ii Srinagar
 Through:
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justicejaved Iqbal Wani, Judge
 Order
03.06.2024 Notice in the main as also in CrlM, returnable within four weeks, upon steps within one week. 
List on 29.07.2024. 
In the meanwhile, subject to objections and till next date of hearing, proceedings in complaint titled as UT of J&K through "Food Safety Officer (Zone II) Srinagar Vs. Ali Mohammad Bhat and others"
being File No. 60342/2023 pending before Chief Judicial Magistrate, Srinagar shall stay insofar as petitioners are concerned. 
Modification, vacation, alteration on motion.
